t: What Insulation Installation Is All About
title: What Insulation Installation Is All About
description: Insulation workers install thermal and acoustic insulation in attics, walls, and floors using batts, blown-in, and spray foam. Air sealing — blocking air leaks — is the trade's highest-value skill. Insulation contractors, weatherization programs, general contractors, and energy-retrofit companies. New construction and old-home retrofits are the core markets. This record lays the foundation: the core purpose, the people it serves, and where it fits in everyday life.

title: History and Evolution
description: Insulation evolved from sawdust and newspaper to fiberglass batts (1930s) to blown cellulose and spray foam. The energy crises of the 1970s turned insulation from optional to code-mandated. Knowing where the trade came from explains why things are done the way they are — and which 'rules' are just old habits.
